Lorelei's Cloyster (Japanese: カンナのパルシェン Kanna's Parshen; known in the dub as Prima's Cloyster) is a owned by Lorelei in the , , and .

==In the manga==
===In the Pokémon Adventures manga===
==== ====
 
Lorelei's Cloyster is one of her main Pokémon. It first appeared along with her in Do Wrong, Dewgong!. Cloyster traps and in a cave by collapsing the entrance with a . When Yellow tries to escape, Cloyster sends an -powered Spike Cannon which stops them. Eventually, they do escape and Yellow attacks with Pika, with it using . Lorelei tells Cloyster to into its shell and Pika's ThunderShock bounces off harmlessly, though it became too stunned to move.

After a long chase, Lorelei gets Cloyster to Yellow and Bill, them in place along with an entire tidal wave. Then, Lorelei tries to extract information from Yellow by getting Cloyster to bombard them with its , Yellow's Rattata comes and rescues them at the last minute with its .

In Valiant Venomoth!, Lorelei appears again, this time riding in her Cloyster, to battle and Sabrina. She uses voodoo dolls made from her to freeze their hands together and present the threat that any part of the dolls that are destroyed means they will, too. Cloyster then uses on them, but it barely misses them. Green sends out Nidorina and Sabrina uses . Nidorina at Cloyster and Venomoth uses . Cloyster uses to blow the Sleep Powder into Nidorina's face which puts her to sleep. Venomoth charges again and again, with Cloyster withdrawing each time so that all the attacks don't hit. Eventually Cloyster falls over, fainted, and Lorelei then realizes that it had been using the whole time.

Cloyster also makes a small appearance getting defeated by a 's in Clefabulous Clefable.

==== ====
When Lorelei later reappeared in the , she used Cloyster again to defeat countless with another Spike Cannon blast, but was taken by surprise when Sird's used to approach them whilst disguised as part of the terrain before it defeated both Cloyster and Lorelei with a .

===Personality and characteristics===
Cloyster has no problem in following Lorelei's commands as shown when she relied on it in order to do dangerous tasks and to prevent anyone from interfering with her plans.

====Moves improvised====
 
 
 
 
===Pokémon Pocket Monsters===
Lorelei's Cloyster appeared in To The Pokémon League. It first appeared along with Lorelei's other Pokémon when Lorelei welcomed to her school. Jynx used it as a weapon by smacking . Later, it sneaked in Clefairy's food bowl, much to his ire. When Lorelei revealed herself to be an Elite Four member, she and Red had a battle, with Cloyster being the second Pokémon that she sent out. It charged at Clefairy, but Clefairy dodged, causing Cloyster to crash into a wall, being knocked out in the process.

===Pokémon Zensho===
During 's time at the Pokémon League in PZ10, Lorelei sends out her Cloyster. Cloyster goes up against Satoshi's who has the type-disadvantage against the . It wasn't long before Cloyster gets taken out by Raichu's , advancing Satoshi to the next room. Cloyster was not seen using any moves due to its brief appearance.

===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
In The Mandarin Island Miss Match, Prima (Lorelei's name in the dub) used Cloyster against numerous opponents in a tournament and defeated them all. Eventually, challenged Prima to a battle. They agreed to use one Pokémon each, and Prima used Cloyster against . Pikachu used a , but Cloyster shielded itself by ing into its shell. Pikachu then used , but Cloyster used and Pikachu got thrown backward. After getting back on his feet, Pikachu used to hit Cloyster, who started to glow red after using to enhance its attack power. Pikachu tried to use , but was defeated by an - combo, causing Ash to lose.
 

====Personality and characteristics====
Very little is known about Prima's Cloyster, as it and its Trainer have only been in one episode. However, being a Pokémon owned by an Elite Four member, it was shown to be quite strong, as it defeated Ash's Pikachu despite being at a type disadvantage.

==In the games==
Lorelei uses Cloyster in every game she appears in, being her only Pokémon to do so.
